dedupe_keys.name: fault test cases for series compensated transmission line with capacitor at line terminal

description: Md Tanbhir publishes simulated transmission-line fault cases and the PSCAD source case for a 500 kV, 200 km series-compensated line. Zenodo provides four output ZIPs, a PSCAD project and a Python automation example under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. The 6,912 cases vary fault location, type, resistance, inception angle, source-impedance ratio and compensation level. Each one-second trace has time and three-phase voltage and current at 10 kHz. These data can benchmark time-domain protection algorithms and fault-location simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this specific series-compensated benchmark. A limitation is that the cases are synthetic and reflect the published line parameters and disabled capacitor-bypass protection, not measured relay performance on a real grid. PSCAD is a separate software dependency. No archive was downloaded, and case count, waveform shape and protection results were not independently checked.
